description: The body of a Canadian tourist killed when a gunman opened fire from one of Mexico's most visited pyramids has been turned over to her family, Mexican officials confirmed.
title: Body of Canadian woman slain in Teotihuacán shooting returned to family

description: A U.S. soldier involved in the military operation to capture Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro has been charged with using classified information about the mission to win more than $400,000 US in an online betting market, federal officials announced Thursday.
title: U.S. soldier involved in Maduro capture accused of profiting from knowledge of raid on Polymarket

description: A couple from the United States is facing international kidnapping charges after prosecutors claimed they took a 10-year-old child to Cuba to potentially undergo gender transition surgery, allegedly deceiving the child's biological mother with a fake Canadian camping trip to get there.
title: Couple accused in international kidnapping case used fake Canadian camping trip as cover story: prosecutors

description: Canada's energy minister said public dollars could flow to Alberta's potential bitumen pipeline to the Pacific Coast through the federal government's Indigenous Loan Guarantee program.
title: Alberta pipeline could receive federal financing through Indigenous loan guarantee program: energy minister

description: A former Beast Industries employee is suing MrBeast's media production company after she was allegedly fired from her social media manager job upon returning from maternity leave and following years of what she described as sexual harassment and workplace gender bias.
title: MrBeast's production company sued over alleged sexual harassment

description: Israel and Lebanon have agreed to extend a ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah by three weeks after talks at the White House on Thursday, according to U.S. President Donald Trump.
title: Lebanon and Israel agree to extend ceasefire for another 3 weeks, Trump says

description: Hot off the heels of the Artemis II mission around the moon that included Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen, another Canadian has been announced for another space mission.
title: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk announced as part of a crew heading to the International Space Station

description: FIFA's release of a new tranche of World Cup tickets has left some fans fuming about a perceived lack of transparency in how seats are being sold, given that premium seating options now on offer were not available previously.
title: FIFA makes more World Cup tickets available, but soccer fans criticize lack of transparency

description: When Ajay Haridasse's legs gave out within sight of the Boston Marathon finish line, two other runners sacrificed their personal bests to help him finish the race.
title: This video of Boston Marathon runners helping a man cross the finish line will heal you

description: The RCMP made six missions to search for Jennifer Hillier-Penney's body in the waters near Hare Bay Islands off St. Anthony, N.L., and searched over 130 points of interest. In his testimony in Corner Brook Supreme Court on Thursday, RCMP Cpl. Steven Hatch said the searches came up with nothing.
title: Dean Penney gave police an exact location to search for Jennifer Hillier-Penney’s body. It came up empty

description: Toronto police officials say they are reaching out to a high-ranking former officer who this week made explosive allegations of antisemitism, racism, and corruption in the service's senior ranks in a series of interviews surrounding the release of his new book.
title: Toronto police want to talk to ex-cop who alleged antisemitism, corruption in senior ranks

description: ‘Much more normal salaried people could buy houses 30 years ago…those days are gone,’ broker Ron Butler said. Butler spoke as a witness for the Standing Committee on Finance, which looks into matters relating to federal finances.
title: $110K/year not enough to buy a home in a major Canadian city: expert

description: Whale-sized, monstrous octopuses prowled the seas during the Age of Dinosaurs, snatching prey with their huge tentacles and crunching them with powerful jaws, fossils from B.C. and Japan suggest.
title: Monstrous octopus terrorized seas off B.C. in Age of Dinosaurs, study suggests

description: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre has announced two new roles for members of his caucus, aimed at developing a strategic plan for the Asia Pacific and responding to a B.C. Supreme Court ruling that some fear threatens property rights.
title: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre showcases MPs with new caucus roles

description: The National Transportation Safety Board has published its preliminary report on the deadly crash between an Air Canada jet and a firetruck at New York's La Guardia airport last month, including a detailed timeline of the events leading up to the collision.
title: Fire truck heard 'stop, stop, stop' before deadly LaGuardia crash but didn't know warning was for them: NTSB

description: A number of accounts creating misleading YouTube videos about Alberta separatism with millions of views appear to have their origins in a Dutch digital marketing course, a CBC/Radio-Canada investigation has found.
title: Dutch YouTube creators behind Alberta separatist videos getting millions of views

description: Crave's hit series Heated Rivalry has won a Peabody Award.
title: Canadian drama Heated Rivalry wins prestigious Peabody Award

description: Global Affairs Canada is postponing the requirement for its unionized employees to be on site four days a week due to a lack of office space, Radio-Canada has learned.
title: 4-day office return for Global Affairs Canada workers delayed over lack of space

description: Canada's new ambassador in Washington said Thursday that trade talks need to move beyond "bluster" as public rhetoric on both sides of the border has heated up in recent weeks.
title: Canada's U.S. ambassador wants to set aside the 'bluster' as rhetoric around trade heats up

description: Prime Minister Mark Carney said he is disappointed that Canada's ambassador to the U.S. issued an English-only invitation to MPs for an upcoming reception in Washington.
title: Carney 'disappointed' in Canada's ambassador in Washington for English-only invite to MPs

description: Newfoundland and Labrador Tourism Minister Andrea Barbour opened Thursday’s House of Assembly session with a tearful speech about bullying she says she’s faced since taking office.
title: In tearful speech, N.L. tourism minister decries 'bullying' following AI controversy

description: At a parliamentary committee hearing on journalism on Thursday, CBC president Marie-Philippe Bouchard denied the public broadcaster's news coverage is biased or that it poaches journalists from smaller media outlets in regional markets.
title: CBC president denies broadcaster is biased or poaches journalists from smaller markets

description: Israeli airstrikes killed at least four Palestinians in Gaza on Thursday, and Israeli soldiers shot and killed a 15-year-old during an army raid in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, Palestinian health officials said.
title: Israeli strikes, fire kill 5 in Gaza and West Bank, medics say

description: The cast of The Devil Wears Prada reunited on the red carpet for the long-awaited sequel to the 2006 hit.
title: IN PHOTOS | Best red carpet looks from The Devil Wears Prada 2

description: Mark Carney and other Canadian prime ministers should be required to divest their investment portfolios when they assume office, not just put them in a blind trust, the House of Commons ethics committee recommends in a new report.
title: Prime minister should be required to divest assets, says committee

description: A Kuwaiti American journalist has been acquitted in Kuwait of all charges after nearly two months in detention during a crackdown on press freedom and social media posts on military activity in the Middle East amid Iran's war with the U.S. and Israel.
title: Kuwaiti court acquits detained U.S. Kuwaiti journalist of all charges, lawyers say

description: An overwhelming majority of Warner Bros. Discovery shareholders voted in support of selling the business to Paramount on Thursday. The approval by shareholders is a big step toward the deal being finalized, which would have big implications for the media landscape.
title: Warner Bros. shareholders approve $81-billion US takeover by Paramount

description: British Columbia doesn't intend to put U.S. products back on B.C. Liquor Store shelves until Canada's trade and tariff war with the United States has been resolved, the province's minister for jobs and economic growth says.
title: B.C. sees 'no reason' to put U.S. booze back on liquor store shelves, minister says

description: Two men who met after immigrating from Europe to London, Ont., in the 1990s are the winners of the largest-ever lottery payout in Canada: A cool total of $80,403,285.40. It eclipses the $80 million won in B.C. last year.
title: Record lottery jackpot in Canada of over $80.4M goes to pair of longtime friends in London, Ont.

description: A snowfall warning that was in place for most of northern Manitoba has intensified into a blizzard warning for the entire region.
title: Northern and central Manitoba hit by ice, fierce winds amid blizzard, freezing rain warnings

description: The shooting death of a Calgary-born astrophysicist in mid-February in front of his Southern California residence sent shockwaves through his academic and professional circles.
title: Killing of Calgary-born scientist tied to mysterious U.S. deaths, disappearances despite quick arrest

description: A fire at a recycling plant in Montréal-Est prompted an investigation by Quebec's Environment Ministry, a health warning from Santé Montréal and caused a plume of thick, white smoke to drape the city in acrid-smelling fumes.
title: Smoke blankets Montreal as recycling plant fire prompts health warning, investigation

description: Innu children are still overrepresented in the child protection system, though far less likely to be removed from their homes than they were nearly a decade ago.
title: Rate of Innu child protection removals has plummeted, but investigations continue to climb

description: The U.S. military on Thursday seized another tanker associated with the smuggling of Iranian oil, ratcheting up a standoff with Iran a day after its paramilitary Revolutionary Guards took control of two vessels in the crucial Strait of Hormuz.
title: U.S. military seizes another oil tanker linked to Iran

description: Brianne Jenner scored with 1:14 left in overtime on Wednesday night, Rebecca Leslie also scored a goal, and the Ottawa Charge beat the Boston Fleet 2-1 at the Tsongas Center in Lowell, Mass.
title: Charge power past Fleet in OT, but playoff spot will be decided on Saturday

description: Kash Patel has transformed and politicized the FBI under Trump. He also faces allegations of erratic behavior, excessive drinking and unexplained absences.
title: The FBI’s controversial Kash Patel

description: Judges at the International Criminal Court on Thursday confirmed all three counts of ‌murder as crimes against humanity against former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte and committed him to trial.
title: Former Philippines president Duterte to stand trial at the Hague for crimes against humanity

description: A Nova Scotia family is speaking out after their 19-year-old son was taken to hospital following multiple suicide attempts. After being assessed, he was sent by taxi to a local homeless shelter. The teen and his parents say it felt like hospital staff were more concerned about clearing a bed than helping him.
title: This 19-year-old attempted suicide. Hospital staff sent him to a homeless shelter

description: Jeanie McKay alleged gender discrimination by York Regional Police because she said they didn't investigate her allegations of historical sexual abuse from the 1980s. She took her case to the Human Rights Tribunal of Ontario, and it was settled with an non-disclosure agreement — a restriction that transparency advocates say shields public institutions from accountability.
title: Abuse survivors unsatisfied after human rights tribunal settlement comes with NDA

description: American media, politicians and other right-wing influencers are paying more attention than ever before to Canada's domestic politics. Why does the MAGAsphere suddenly care so much, and what does it mean for Canada?
title: Americans are paying more attention to Canada. Should we worry?

description: Neskantaga First Nation has been under a state of emergency since last April after its only nursing station flooded. Local leaders say access to health care hasn’t improved in the remote Ojibway community, which has also been under a boil-water advisory for 31 years, and community members face ongoing challenges accessing timely medical transportation for appointments in other areas.
title: First Nation in Ontario called for immediate health-care help amid year-long state of emergency

description: Enter admin parties, the modern equivalent of a good old-fashioned barn-raising. Billed as “the new book club,” they are rising in popularity, as people gather with some friends, maybe a glass of wine, and the metaphorical stack of paperwork that’s been weighing them down.
title: Haven't filed your taxes? Pick up some pizza, call your friends and throw an admin party

description: Two of the biggest global names in Punjabi music are set to take over Canada’s largest venues — underscoring the genre’s explosive rise worldwide. Diljit Dosanjh and Karan Aujla are launching Canadian tours drawing demand promoters say rivals some of the biggest names in hip-hop.
title: Tickets for Punjabi pop concerts are selling fast — especially in Canada

description: Because the budget has yet to pass, specific guidance on the rebate is not yet available. To get an understanding of what we do know about it, CBC News spoke with real estate experts on how it could work and what it means for buyers.
title: Want to take advantage of Ontario’s temporary HST rebate on new homes? Here’s what you need to know

description: Fresh veggies cost 7.8 per cent more in March compared to March last year, according to Statistics Canada's most recent inflation numbers. And the worst offender? The mighty cucumber.
title: Why are veggies so expensive? Consumers crunched by climbing cucumber costs
